The '''Maill system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Cadavine sector/Legends|Cadavine sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Maill]].
